verdict: UNSTABLE ACROSS PROTOCOLS -- NOT BENCHMARKABLE AS THINGS STAND. Only 1 of 3 power-conditioning protocols give a positive net (P1 stratified -0.0257, P2 residualised -0.0046, P3 rank-in-stratum +0.0410), so they disagree about whether anything survives. And the one that is positive, P3 rank-in-stratum, gains mostly from replacing a heavy-tailed target with a uniform one rather than from removing power: a GLOBAL rank, which conditions on nothing, scores +0.0226, leaving only +0.0184 attributable to the conditioning itself. The recommendation is therefore the rank-based target for VARIANCE reasons, with power-conditioning on top, and a measured floor near zero for biology -- not a claim that magnitude has become predictable.
